1.title: Pentagon Identifies 2 U.S. Soldiers Killed in Jordan During Iran Strike
1.summary: Both were active-duty soldiers, the Defense Department said. They were killed in action after an Iranian strike on a U.S. base on Friday.

2.title: Notorious drug cartel leader Ismael Zambada sentenced to life in US prison
2.summary: Known as "El Mayo", he helped found the Sinaloa Cartel and admitted to sending vast amounts of cocaine and other drugs to the US.

3.title: Denise Oliver-Velez, a Powerful Voice of the Left, Dies at 78
3.summary: She became the highest-ranking female member of the Young Lords in New York, where she pressed for women’s rights, and later joined the Black Panthers.

4.title: Aiming for My Fastest Marathon, I Turned to Distance Running’s Mecca
4.summary: A New York Times reporter’s quest to beat the personal best he set 14 years ago took him to a Kenyan village, where the biggest benefit he got was not what he expected.

5.title: Police block thousands of 'cockroach' protesters marching on India's parliament
5.summary: Some protesters demanding education reforms said they were injured in clashes with police who banned the march.

6.title: Ten killed as Russian attacks on merchant ships in Black Sea intensify
6.summary: Russian strikes on the Odesa region have killed 28 people in July alone, local authorities say.
